method: Deterministic title rule over the 13 local Shorts not used by any selection, ingest or library (census.csv minus videos/, asset_library/, selection/*.json, heldout_v7/v8 selections). No frame, sheet or measurement of any candidate opened before the freeze.

exposure: Neither Short has been ingested or viewed. Parents are title matches (INFERRED); a caption/ASR overlap check is done after ingest and reported.
